newsitem.title: USA: Lightning and rain kill two in north Texas.
newsitem.headline: Lightning and rain kill two in north Texas.

text.p: A truck driver and a 2-year-old boy were killed by lightning and heavy rains that lashed north Texas Wednesday, police said.
Dean Olson, 50, was struck by lightning when he climbed out of his 18-wheel truck to help a driver who had spun out of control and crashed on a highway near Dallas.

"As he was walking along the shoulder, lightning struck him and killed him immediately," said police Sgt. David Landers. "It went through his body and struck the ground ... It blew bits of concrete all over the road."
He said the gash left in the road was three inches thick, five inches wide and 12 inches long.
Police said a 2-year-old boy was killed near the town of Justin when high waters swept his mother's car off the road. The woman and her other young son survived.
Lashing rains flooded dozens of roads across north Texas throughout much of the day.
